paper_sentence: P(flag) 0.216 at n=117 -> 0.484 at full scale
finding: 0.216 is the COHORT bootstrap P(kappa<=0.60) at n=117; 0.484 is the AUDIT-DRAW P(flag) at n=74,829. Different estimands. At demo scale the audit subset IS the whole cohort (min(500,117)=117 drawn without replacement), so the audit-draw estimand has zero variance and gives P=0.000. Like-for-like on the cohort bootstrap, full scale is ~0.22, essentially demo's 0.216. The demo kappa CI also contains the full-cohort value, so the two estimates are not distinguishable.
